blind.description: No text or labels can be read in any of the images. The model is a stylized stone pillar or display pedestal consisting of a flat square top platform, a decorative capital carved with a stylized winged or horned face, an octagonal/faceted shaft divided by a horizontal moulding ring with dark inset panels bearing embossed four-pointed star emblems, and a tiered square plinth base. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. There are no hovering unattached elements and no melted or fused geometry. It stands on its own integrated stepped base, which sits flat against the floor. Materials resemble hand-painted cool grey stone with dark slate-blue panel insets and lighter edge highlights; there are no unpainted black areas, flames, or glow effects.
blind.from_above: From straight above (Tile C), it looks like a flat, dark slate-grey square surface surrounded by a lighter grey bevelled rim, with small darker accents at the corners; it appears essentially as a square dark tile, slab, or tabletop.
blind.height_vs_figure: The model is approximately 9 to 10 feet tall, roughly 1.6 to 1.7 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (the figure reaches just past the mid-height ring on the pillar's shaft). Its top platform and base are about 4 to 4.3 feet wide, roughly three times the diameter of the scale figure's cylinder.
